title: wtsi-hgi/hlarnaseq pipeline - params.rna_samples schema
description: Schema for the RNA samples manifest provided with params.rna_samples

rna_id.errorMessage: RNA sample ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

bam.errorMessage: RNA BAM path must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bam'

bai.errorMessage: RNA BAM index path must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bai'

unpaired_r1.errorMessage: Unpaired read 1 FASTQ must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

unpaired_r2.errorMessage: Unpaired read 2 FASTQ must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'
